title: orders.v1.OrderConfirmed
description: The saga completed every forward step: stock is deducted, money is captured, the order is terminal. This is the event that means a sale happened. Emitted exactly once per order.

payment_id.description: The captured payment. Included so that a consumer reconciling orders against money does not need to join through a third topic.

reservation_id.description: The committed stock reservation. Optional: an order whose lines require no physical stock has no reservation, and during the incremental build of this system the saga ran its payment steps before the inventory steps existed. Present whenever inventory participated in the order.
